estimates.assumptions: 3 cups dry skinless fava/broad beans (approx. 510 g total); standard dry fava bean nutrition (53.6 g carbs, 14.2 g fiber per 100 g)
6 spring onions/scallions, approx. 90 g total edible portion (standard scallion nutrition)
4 garlic cloves, approx. 12 g total (standard garlic nutrition)
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, approx. 15 g (standard parsley nutrition)
2 tsp ground cumin (approx. 4 g; standard cumin nutrition)
1 tsp baking powder (approx. 4 g; standard baking powder nutrition)
1/2 tsp cayenne pepper (approx. 1 g; standard cayenne nutrition)
modest sprinkling of flour for coating (estimated 10 g total used; standard wheat flour nutrition)
oil absorbed during frying; approx. 10 tbsp / 140 g total absorbed by all patties (pure oil has no carbohydrates)
